details.effect: [act] [engage], give your leader [defense]-1: Select a follower that costs 2 play points or less in your cemetery and put it onto your field. Whenever another Demon follower is put onto your field, give your leader [defense]+1.

issues: Activated ability cost is incomplete. Source says "[engage], give your leader [defense]-1" but parsed only includes engage. Add the leader self-damage/heal-negative-1 cost before the cemetery summon effect.

Activated ability uses the wrong operation. It should put a selected follower that costs 2 play points or less from your cemetery onto your field, so use summonFromCemetery with filter cardType follower and maxCost 2, not tutorFromCemetery to field.

Triggered heal ability is missing its condition. Source says "Whenever another Demon follower is put onto your field," so the trigger should filter for Demon followers entering and exclude this card itself; parsed currently heals on any ally follower entering.

details.effect: [evolve] [cost02]: Evolve this follower. At the start of each opponent's main phase, recover 1 play point.
